details: The package runs a preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from the official oven-sh GitHub release and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) at install time. The script is obfuscated with a custom encoded string-array and decoder, hiding its behaviour from inspection. The package also depends on @or-sdk/base and @or-sdk/providers, which are known-malicious packages in the same namespace. Installing this package executes the obfuscated payload on the victim's machine.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
